verified_items.headline: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-5.5 Instant Globally as New Default Model
verified_items.summary: GPT-5.5 Instant has replaced GPT-5.3 as the default ChatGPT model, offering 52% fewer hallucinations in professional domains and deep integration with Drive and Gmail for Plus users. The model focuses on clarity and reduced verbosity.

verified_items.headline: Microsoft Pivots to 'Agentic Autonomy' with Launch of Agent 365 and E7 Suite
verified_items.summary: Microsoft has officially shifted its strategy from assistants to autonomous agents, introducing Agent 365 for governance and the Microsoft 365 E7 enterprise tier. The shift addresses the 'Transformation Paradox' where work design lags behind AI capability.

verified_items.headline: Microsoft Assumes Operational Control of $500B Stargate Project
verified_items.summary: Microsoft has taken the lead on the 'Stargate' infrastructure alliance with OpenAI, SoftBank, and Oracle. The project aims for 10GW of power by 2030, with Microsoft securing Norway capacity while OpenAI pauses UK operations.

verified_items.headline: Unsloth Studio (Beta) Drops: Open-Source No-Code UI for Local LLM Training
verified_items.summary: Unsloth has launched a web UI for training 500+ models locally with 2x speed and 70% VRAM reduction. It features self-healing tool calling and automated dataset creation from local files.

verified_items.headline: Sam Altman Warns of 'AI Washing' in Recent Corporate Layoffs
verified_items.summary: In a CNBC-TV18 interview, Altman stated that companies are using AI as a scapegoat for layoffs to signal innovation to investors, while the 'real impact' on the labor market is still 24-36 months away.

verified_items.headline: Dario Amodei Teases Claude 5 with 'Extended Thinking' for Q2 2026
verified_items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei detailed the Claude 5 roadmap, featuring a breakthrough 50,000-token internal reasoning mode and a target of >90% on SWE-bench Verified. He predicts a 'Genius Nation' in data centers by 2027.

verified_items.headline: GPU Market Bifurcation: B200 Premiums Surge as H100 Prices Stabilize
verified_items.summary: B200 Blackwell chips command extreme premiums due to memory shortages, while H100 pricing has partially rebounded driven by massive inference demand. HBM3e costs now account for 45% of total manufacturing spend.

verified_items.headline: Research Trend: 'HeavySkill' and 'Workspace-Bench' Dominate Trending Papers
verified_items.summary: New research on Hugging Face focuses on 'Heavy Thinking' for agents to reduce hallucination-driven actions and 'Workspace-Bench 1.0' for testing AI in real-world office environments with complex dependencies.

verified_items.headline: The 2026 Code Editor Power Stack: Cursor for UX, Claude Code for Reasoning
verified_items.summary: A hands-on comparison of 2026 AI editors shows Cursor leading in daily UI features, while Claude Code (powered by Opus 4.7) dominates in complex refactoring and architectural changes with its 1M context window.
